Includes /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup fallback, dynamic column auto-sizing, and JSON export.

summary: Operational, diagnostic, and kernel security release introducing bare-metal process inspection (anode ps) with cgroups v2 resource accounting, decoupled 2-phase pre-flight network diagnostics (anode doctor), anti-jailbreak systemd confinement, and in-memory streaming SCP binary deployment.
highlights: Bare-Metal Process Inspection (anode ps): Direct systemd service inspection with zero container engine overhead.
Cgroups v2 Resource Accounting: Real-time memory.current vs MemoryMax=1G tracking with smaps PSS/RSS fallback.
Decoupled Pre-Flight Diagnostics (anode doctor): 2-phase verification isolating closed port 22/firewalls from SSH auth rejections.
Caddy Edge Route Mapping: Automatically resolves upstream loopback ports to public internet-facing domains.
Anti-Jailbreak Kernel Confinement: DynamicUser=yes, ProtectProc=invisible, ProcSubset=pid, and RestrictNamespaces=true.
In-Memory Streaming SCP: Replaces /tmp staging writes with direct encrypted in-memory byte streaming.

updates.title: anode doctor: Decoupled 2-Phase Pre-Flight Verification
updates.description: Executes a sub-100ms sanity check prior to deployment. Decoupled into two distinct phases: Phase 1 executes a raw TCP dial (strict 3s deadline) to catch firewalls, closed port 22, or bad DNS; Phase 2 performs the SSH auth handshake to diagnose rejected keys. Validates Go static cross-compilation (CGO_ENABLED=0), local loopback address space (127.0.0.0/8), and container runtime availability.

updates.title: Anti-Jailbreak Systemd Kernel Confinement
updates.description: Rigorous multi-tenant process confinement: DynamicUser=yes assigns transient unprivileged UIDs, ProtectSystem=strict mounts the filesystem read-only, ProtectProc=invisible and ProcSubset=pid conceal neighboring processes from /proc, and LockPersonality=true, MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true, and RestrictNamespaces=true block namespace escapes and runtime memory rewriting.

RestrictNamespaces=true
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM

updates.title: In-Memory Streaming SCP Deployments (StreamBytes)
updates.description: Replaced temporary /tmp staging file writes during remote deployment with direct in-memory SCP streaming over encrypted SSH channels. Eliminates world-writable file race conditions, symlink traversal attacks, and multi-tenant disk probing on target VPS hosts.

updates.title: Caddy Edge Route Reverse Resolution
updates.description: Inspects active Caddy reverse-proxy configurations to map backend loopback ports (e.g. 127.0.0.1:8080) directly back to their internet-facing domain hostnames with automated Let's Encrypt TLS status reporting.

summary: Initial general availability release of Anode — the Proof-of-Topology bare-metal orchestrator for unmodified Go backends. Eliminates Docker and Kubernetes by compiling unmodified Go AST and SSA call graphs directly into hardened Linux systemd unit files, dynamic loopback networks, and automated Caddy TLS reverse proxies.
highlights: 4-Pillar Proof of Topology Engine: Migration-driven stateful provisioning, typed gRPC/HTTP route linking, commit-backed anode.lock.json, and actionable diagnostic compiler warnings.
Whole-Program Go SSA & VTA: Compiler pipeline analyzing standard library choke points and backward taint tracking in under 60ms.
Bare-Metal VPS Deployer (anode deploy): Cross-compilation (arm64/amd64), hardened systemd unit sandboxing, and Linux cgroups v2 resource ceilings (CPUQuota, MemoryMax).
Local Dev Orchestrator (anode dev): Ephemeral kernel socket allocation (127.0.0.1:0) guaranteeing 0% port collisions with sub-second hot reload.
Pluggable Infrastructure Catalog: 28 out-of-the-box stateful drivers with intelligent version matrix resolution and least-privilege security.
Cluster & Security Engine (anode cluster): Multi-node greedy least-loaded bin-packer and compiler-synthesized nftables zero-trust firewall policy.
Enterprise & Real-World Benchmarks: Evaluated across OmniMesh-32, HealthMesh-25, Fintech Core 20, and 10 famous open-source Go backends.
Soft-Orphan Volume Protection: Prevents accidental data loss by refusing to drop persistent volumes without explicit confirmation.

updates.title: 4-Pillar Proof of Topology Engine
updates.description: Foundational engine guaranteeing mathematical parity between local development and production. Pillar 1 (Database Provenance) ensures stateful stores are provisioned only when verifiable migration assets (migrations/*.sql or Goose) exist. Pillar 2 (Typed Interface Linking) maps gRPC client stubs (New<X>Client) to server registrations (Register<X>Server) and HTTP router tables (chi, gin, echo, Go 1.22+ http.ServeMux). Pillar 3 (Commit-Backed Lockfile) produces deterministic anode.lock.json files. Pillar 4 (Actionable Diagnostics) emits precise compiler warnings with file:line provenance.

updates.title: Whole-Program Go SSA & Variable Type Analysis (VTA)
updates.description: Proprietary static analysis pipeline using golang.org/x/tools/go/ssa. Builds a Variable Type Analysis (VTA) call graph rooted strictly at func main(), mathematically pruning dead code and mock test drivers. Detects standard library choke points on database/sql.Open, pgxpool.New, net.Listen, and http.ListenAndServe, with recursive backward taint tracking through structs, ssa.Store, ssa.FieldAddr, and fmt.Sprintf varargs slices.

updates.title: Bare-Metal VPS Deployer (anode deploy / anode run)
updates.description: Builds pure static Go ELF binaries locally (CGO_ENABLED=0) with automatic target architecture detection (uname -m -> arm64/amd64). Deploys to Linux VPS hosts with hardened systemd units (NoNewPrivileges=true, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=true, PrivateTmp=true, PrivateDevices=true, ProtectKernelTunables=true, RestrictSUIDSGID=true), Linux cgroups v2 quotas (CPUQuota=200%, MemoryMax=1G), zero-downtime blue/green port swaps, and automated Caddy reverse proxy synthesis with Let's Encrypt TLS.

updates.title: Local Dev Orchestrator (anode dev)
updates.description: Provides zero-collision local microservice orchestration. Allocates dynamic kernel sockets via net.ListenTCP('tcp', '127.0.0.1:0') to guarantee 0% host port collisions. Injects both unified DSN (DATABASE_URL) and decomposed credentials (DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER), executes automated migrations prior to boot, and supervises sub-second file-watching hot-reloads.

updates.title: Pluggable Infrastructure Catalog (anode catalog)
updates.description: Declarative service catalog (defaults.yaml) supporting 28 pre-audited stateful drivers including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, TimescaleDB, Redis, Valkey, KeyDB, Dragonfly, Memcached, Kafka/Redpanda, RabbitMQ, NATS, ClickHouse, MongoDB, ScyllaDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, MinIO, and Temporal. Enforces strict least-privilege security container configurations with non-root UIDs, 0700 POSIX directory isolation, no-new-privileges:true, --oom-score-adj=-900 kernel protection, and 127.0.0.1 loopback binding.

updates.title: Cluster & Security Engine (anode cluster)
updates.description: Multi-node greedy least-loaded bin-packer for distributing services across registered VPS instances. Synthesizes Linux kernel nftables firewall policies directly from compiler topology: drops all undeclared lateral container traffic by default, permitting only explicitly declared egress routes.

updates.title: Enterprise & Real-World Benchmark Verification
updates.description: Validated against enterprise synthetic meshes including OmniMesh-32 (32 services, 14 drivers), HealthMesh-25 (25 microservices), Fintech Core 20 (20 microservices), as well as 10 famous unmodified open-source Go repositories: croc, glance, 1Panel, restic, filebrowser, ntfy, netbird, wttr.in, cloudreve, and navidrome. Harmonized SSA sweep profiles achieve sub-100ms on single-service backends scaling to 799ms on a 32-service enterprise monorepo.

updates.title: Soft-Orphan Volume Protection & Reliability
updates.description: To safeguard production data during topology refactoring, Anode marks decommissioned stateful resources as 'lifecycle: orphaned' and refuses to drop persistent database volumes automatically without an explicit --confirm flag.

updates.title: Docker-Style CLI Experience & Distribution
updates.description: Clean Docker-style synopsis: 'Usage: anode [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARG...]' with subcommands inspect, dev, deploy (anode run alias), catalog, and cluster. Distributed via official Homebrew tap (brew install abhiudayg/tap/anode), one-line curl install script (install.sh), and automated multi-arch GitHub Actions CI/CD (darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, linux/amd64, linux/arm64).
